description: This file defines a Fragment class for Android that manages camera connection, preview setup, and image capture using Camera2 API. It is tailored for a TensorFlow demo application, handling camera preview flow and interactions.

classes.name: CameraConnectionFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that manages camera connection, preview size selection, transform configuration, and camera lifecycle for a TensorFlow demo application.

classes.name: CameraConnectionFragment.ErrorDialog
classes.description: A DialogFragment for displaying error messages related to camera setup failures.

methods.name: chooseOptimalSize
methods.description: Selects the optimal camera preview size based on supported sizes, desired dimensions, and constraints.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CameraConnectionFragment with specified parameters.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes view components after view inflation.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Performs setup tasks after activity creation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts background thread and initializes camera upon resuming.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes camera and stops background thread when pausing.

methods.name: setCamera
methods.description: Sets the camera ID used for camera connection.

methods.name: setUpCameraOutputs
methods.description: Configures camera parameters, size, and orientation based on device capabilities.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Opens the camera device for preview and image capture.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Closes camera device and related resources.

methods.name: createCameraPreviewSession
methods.description: Sets up capture session for camera preview display.

methods.name: configureTransform
methods.description: Applies transformation matrix to the TextureView based on device rotation and preview size.
